name: f3-missing-not-clean
alt: A record of seven passages with one missing. A reader that trusts the record reads what it holds, jumps over the gap without reading it and says fine. probity-verify reads the record against the source capture, halts at the gap and returns contradicted: this passage is missing from the record, reason selected_span_missing_from_record. The two verdicts sit in one column.
words: this passage is missing from the record
